items.title: Kenny Davern interviewed by Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, September 23, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Walter Cronkite when he was anchor on CBS had Dizzy Gillespie and Miles Davis

ctx.x: But you have a very distinct voice on that instrument. You’ve taken that instrument past any generic conception into this elusive category that all musicians seek called “voice.” And you have that.

Thank you. That I think is a prerequisite for anybody doing anything, is to put their “John Hancock” you know, once you’ve seen that signature it’s forever imprinted on your mind. And I think the only way you can ever establish yourself is to have something like the cookie cutter, according to that syndrome, is you must take it upon yourself to bite the bullet and say, for better or for worse, this is the way I sound. This is the sound that I make. And you must stand by it. And that’s why this, you know “you’re…
